text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. It involves two main tasks: image recognition, which identifies what is in a picture (like a cat or a tree), and object detection, which finds where objects are located and labels them. This technology has many practical applications. For example, in medicine, it helps doctors analyze X-rays to spot diseases early. In retail, it can track inventory on shelves. Perhaps most importantly, computer vision powers self-driving cars, allowing them to recognize traffic lights, pedestrians, and other vehicles in real time. As this technology improves, it will continue to change how we interact with machines.
